text:
deploy-bot: Manual approval requested for PROD gate
service: api-gateway
environment: production
commit: abc1234def (author: daria)
tag: release/v2.3.1
change_window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
reason: rolling datastore migration + schema toggle
required_approvers: 2
link: https://ci.internal/runs/9876 -> canary metrics, traces

alice.k: seeing canary in us-west1 started, 5/10 instances healthy, no errors yet. pulling up slow queries.

ben_p: heads-up — last migration had a short 5xx spike on writes. can we pin read replicas to v2.2.7 if needed?

daria: confirmed migration script includes backfill gating and feature-flag toggle. i've pinned the new model to tag v2.3.1 in the deploy config. fallback is v2.2.7 as discussed.

ci-cd-bot: Canary rollout progress: 30% -> 60% -> 100% in us-west1 (10:03, 10:06, 10:12 UTC). No fatal errors in health checks.

eric: @alice.k can you share the slow query sample? if it's read-only we should be okay to proceed, but if writes are affected i'd hold.

alice.k: sample pasted: `SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE last_active > now()-interval '7 days'` hitting seq scan on big table. likely unrelated to migration, but i'll apply a temporary index on canary nodes.

ben_p: i'm +0 to proceed but want at least two approvers. waiting for @daria or @eric.

daria: Approve — manual prod gate accepted. :white_check_mark:

eric: Approve (after quick trace review). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Manual approval threshold met (2/2). Proceeding with staged rollout to remaining regions: eu-west1, ap-southeast1.

ci-cd-bot: Deploy started: tag=release/v2.3.1 commit=abc1234def regions=[eu-west1,ap-southeast1]

alice.k: monitoring dashboards show no error rate increase in eu-west1 at +3min. CPU stable.

ben_p: noting in thread: rollback plan ready -> `kubectl set image ... release:v2.2.7 && rollback-migration` if we see >1% 5xx sustained for 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: SUCCESS. All regions healthy. Release notes snippet: "api-gateway v2.3.1 — datastore migration, query performance tweaks, feature flag toggle for new session tracking."

alice.k: thanks everyone. i'll post full release notes + post-deploy checklist in #eng-releases-docs. :party_parrot:
